05–08: Third attacker rushes from behind. ChuksAi spins 180°, drops low, uses the fallen attacker as temporary cover, and counters the incoming attack. Dynamic handheld camera and speed-ramping.

08–10: Final attacker raises his weapon. ChuksAi throws his empty weapon to distract him, grabs the attacker’s weapon during the struggle, and delivers a final cinematic shot. The attacker crashes through a hotel door. Slow motion debris. ChuksAi stands calmly as the camera pushes toward him.

Rules: No gore, nudity, fantasy, superpowers, anime, cartoon style, teleportation, cloning, or character changes. Maintain exact ChuksAi appearance and clothing throughout.
